claims.claim: PayPal reported Q2 2026 revenue of $8.68B, up 5% year over year, with TPV growth and continued Venmo/Braintree momentum.
Venmo TPV grew 14%, BNPL TPV grew 26%, and Venmo Debit Card monthly active accounts grew more than 50%, indicating expanding engagement beyond legacy checkout.

risks.risk: Payments competition and mix shifts can pressure transaction economics even as TPV grows.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of engagement gains and monetization across newer Venmo/BNPL products requires continued observation.

claims.claim: Q2 operating cash flow was $1.98B and free cash flow $1.78B; PayPal repurchased $1.5B of shares during the quarter.
Management raised 2026 adjusted EPS expectations to about $5.38 and transaction-margin-dollar outlook to about $15.6B, reversing an earlier expectation for slight decline in the latter.

risks.risk: Adjusted EPS growth remains modest relative to TPV and cash-flow expansion, making transaction-margin execution a key watch item.

unknowns.unknown: How much of the cash-flow improvement is structurally repeatable versus working-capital/timing effects requires Alpha review.
